ex.en: The computer has a virus.
ex.zh: 那台電腦中毒了。

ex.en: My computer has already been infected with the BraveSentry virus.
ex.zh: 我的電腦已經中了 BraveSentry 病毒。

virus.en: a harmful computer program that spreads and damages files or systems

ex.en: The virus is starting to mutate.
ex.zh: 病毒開始變異了。

ex.en: Ebola is one of the most virulent viruses known to man.
ex.zh: 伊波拉是人類已知最致命的病毒之一。

virus.en: a very small living thing that causes disease in people, animals or plants

ex.en: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.
ex.zh: 水果富含維生素和礦物質。

ex.en: Carrots contain a lot of vitamin A.
ex.zh: 胡蘿蔔含有大量維生素 A。

ex.en: Even chocolate contains vitamins.
ex.zh: 連巧克力也含有維生素。

vitamin.en: a natural substance in food that the body needs to stay healthy

ex.en: Smoking here is a violation of company policy.
ex.zh: 在這裡抽菸違反公司規定。

ex.en: The company was fined for safety violations.
ex.zh: 這家公司因違反安全規定被罰款。

violation.en: an act that breaks a rule, law or agreement

ex.en: You should practice playing the violin every day.
ex.zh: 你應該每天練習拉小提琴。

ex.en: Who is the man playing the violin?
ex.zh: 那個在拉小提琴的男人是誰？

ex.en: He is very good at playing violin.
ex.zh: 他小提琴拉得很好。

violin.en: a wooden musical instrument with strings, played with a bow

ex.en: I will never violate a law again.
ex.zh: 我再也不會違法了。

ex.en: He violated a law.
ex.zh: 他違法了。

ex.en: Tom always violates copyright laws.
ex.zh: 湯姆老是違反著作權法。

violate.en: to break a law or rule, or to not respect someone's rights

ex.en: We'll hold a videoconference with the Tokyo office.
ex.zh: 我們會和東京辦公室開視訊會議。

ex.en: The interview was conducted by videoconference.
ex.zh: 面試是透過視訊會議進行的。

videoconference.en: a meeting in which people in different places see and talk to each other using screens

ex.en: Have you ever tried virtual reality?
ex.zh: 你有沒有體驗過虛擬實境？

ex.en: We had a virtual meeting this morning.
ex.zh: 我們今天早上開了視訊會議。

ex.en: The museum offers a virtual tour online.
ex.zh: 博物館提供線上虛擬導覽。

virtual.en: made by a computer or done online, not in the real world

ex.en: The town came to a virtual standstill.
ex.zh: 整個小鎮幾乎陷入停擺。

ex.en: He was a virtual stranger to me.
ex.zh: 他對我來說幾乎是個陌生人。

virtual.en: almost completely something, even if it is not officially so

ex.en: Honesty is a virtue.
ex.zh: 誠實是一種美德。

ex.en: Showing your real feelings is not considered a virtue in Japan.
ex.zh: 在日本，直接表達真實感受並不被視為美德。

virtue.en: a good quality in a person's character

ex.en: The virtue of this plan is its simplicity.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的優點在於簡單。

ex.en: One virtue of the new system is speed.
ex.zh: 新系統的一個優點是速度快。

virtue.en: a good feature that makes something better than other things

ex.en: She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.
ex.zh: 她靠著努力和生意頭腦成了有錢人。

ex.en: He got the job by virtue of his experience.
ex.zh: 他憑著經驗得到了這份工作。

virtue.en: used to show the reason or the thing that makes something happen

ex.en: Is this plan financially viable?
ex.zh: 這個計畫在財務上可行嗎？

ex.en: We need to find a viable alternative.
ex.zh: 我們需要找到可行的替代方案。

viable.en: able to work well and be successful

ex.en: My work at the TV station is handling letters written in by viewers.
ex.zh: 我在電視台的工作是處理觀眾來信。

ex.en: The show attracted millions of viewers.
ex.zh: 這個節目吸引了數百萬名觀眾。

viewer.en: a person who watches television or a film

ex.en: Please select a language for the Image Viewer interface.
ex.zh: 請為 Image Viewer 選擇介面語言。

ex.en: Open the file with a PDF viewer.
ex.zh: 用 PDF 檢視器開啟這個檔案。

viewer.en: a computer program that lets you look at files such as pictures or documents

ex.en: The doctor is known to everyone in the village.
ex.zh: 村裡每個人都認識這位醫生。

ex.en: This is the village where the poet was born.
ex.zh: 這是那位詩人出生的村子。

ex.en: She was born in a remote village in Nepal.
ex.zh: 她出生在尼泊爾一個偏遠的村莊。

village.en: a very small town in the countryside

ex.en: I think you haven't watched the video till the end.
ex.zh: 我覺得你還沒把影片看完。

ex.en: Tom makes TikTok videos.
ex.zh: 湯姆在拍 TikTok 影片。

ex.en: The training video is about ten minutes long.
ex.zh: 這支訓練影片大約十分鐘長。

video.en: a recording of moving pictures and sound that you can watch

ex.en: I'd rather skip school and play video games.
ex.zh: 我寧願翹課去打電動。

ex.en: We had a video call with our client in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我們和東京的客戶開了視訊會議。

video.en: relating to moving pictures shown on a screen

ex.en: The number of visitors to Singapore has increased year by year.
ex.zh: 到新加坡的遊客人數逐年增加。

ex.en: The visitor sat across from me.
ex.zh: 那位訪客坐在我對面。

ex.en: We had a lot of visitors yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們昨天有很多訪客。

visitor.en: a person who goes to see a person or place for a short time

ex.en: Violence is the cancer of our society.
ex.zh: 暴力是社會的毒瘤。

ex.en: Tom didn't want any violence.
ex.zh: 湯姆不希望發生任何暴力。

ex.en: The film contains some scenes of violence.
ex.zh: 這部電影含有一些暴力場面。

violence.en: behavior that is meant to hurt or kill people

ex.en: She is the victim of this incident.
ex.zh: 她是這起事件的受害者。

ex.en: The victims of the earthquake disaster are numerous.
ex.zh: 這場地震的受害者人數眾多。

ex.en: Several thousand people became victims of this disease.
ex.zh: 數千人成了這種疾病的受害者。

victim.en: a person who has been hurt, killed or harmed by a crime, accident or bad event

ex.en: My vision is getting worse these days.
ex.zh: 我最近視力越來越差。

ex.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
ex.zh: 可能的副作用包括視力模糊和呼吸急促。

ex.en: I'll check your vision.
ex.zh: 我來檢查你的視力。

ex.en: The CEO shared her vision for the company.
ex.zh: 執行長分享了她對公司的願景。

ex.en: We need a leader with vision.
ex.zh: 我們需要一位有遠見的領導者。

vision.en: a clear idea of what you want the future to be, or the ability to plan wisely

ex.en: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
ex.zh: 最後，他們嚐到了勝利的喜悅。

ex.en: The biggest victory is to win over yourself.
ex.zh: 最大的勝利是戰勝自己。

ex.en: They congratulated us on our victory.
ex.zh: 他們恭喜我們獲勝。

victory.en: the act of winning a game, fight or competition

ex.en: Virtually everyone in the office uses this software.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡幾乎每個人都用這套軟體。

ex.en: The town was virtually empty on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天鎮上幾乎空無一人。

ex.en: The conference will be held virtually this year.
ex.zh: 今年的研討會將以線上方式舉行。

ex.en: We met virtually because of the typhoon.
ex.zh: 因為颱風，我們改成線上開會。

virtually.en: by using computers or the internet instead of being in the same place

ex.en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
ex.zh: 摩天大樓裡的電梯是極為重要的系統。

ex.en: Regular exercise is vital for good health.
ex.zh: 規律運動對健康極為重要。

ex.en: Your support is vital to the success of this project.
ex.zh: 你的支持對這個專案的成功至關重要。

ex.en: They nominated Calvin Coolidge for vice president.
ex.zh: 他們提名卡爾文·柯立芝為副總統候選人。

ex.en: She was promoted to vice president of sales.
ex.zh: 她被升為業務副總裁。

vice.en: used before a job title to mean the person ranking just below the top one

ex.en: I help him with English, and vice versa.
ex.zh: 我幫他學英文，他也幫我。

ex.en: Cats don't like dogs, and vice versa.
ex.zh: 貓不喜歡狗，狗也不喜歡貓。

vice.en: used to say that the opposite is also true

ex.en: Smoking is his only vice.
ex.zh: 抽菸是他唯一的壞習慣。

ex.en: Gambling is a common vice.
ex.zh: 賭博是常見的惡習。

vice.en: a bad habit or a weakness in someone's character

ex.en: The design has strong visual appeal.
ex.zh: 這個設計很有視覺吸引力。

ex.en: Visual aids make a presentation easier to follow.
ex.zh: 視覺輔助工具讓簡報更容易理解。

visual.en: relating to seeing or to what you can see

ex.en: The presentation needs better visuals.
ex.zh: 這份簡報需要更好的圖像。

ex.en: Can you add some visuals to the report?
ex.zh: 你可以在報告裡加一些圖表嗎？

visual.en: a picture, photo or film used to show or explain something

ex.en: That star is visible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 那顆星星用肉眼就看得到。

ex.en: It is visible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 肉眼可見。

ex.en: Tom rolled up his trouser legs, making his bright red socks visible.
ex.zh: 湯姆捲起褲管，露出鮮紅色的襪子。

ex.en: There has been a visible improvement in sales.
ex.zh: 銷售有明顯的改善。

ex.en: The changes were clearly visible to customers.
ex.zh: 顧客明顯感受得到這些改變。

visible.en: easy to notice or clear to see

ex.en: Cruelty in young people is fostered by violent movies and PC games.
ex.zh: 暴力電影和電玩助長了年輕人的殘忍行為。

ex.en: The movie is too violent for children.
ex.zh: 這部電影對小孩來說太暴力了。

violent.en: involving physical force that hurts or kills people

ex.en: A violent storm hit the coast last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚一場猛烈的暴風雨襲擊沿岸。

ex.en: He woke up with a violent headache.
ex.zh: 他醒來時頭痛欲裂。

violent.en: very strong and powerful, and able to cause damage

ex.en: I still have vivid memories of my first job.
ex.zh: 我對第一份工作仍記憶猶新。

ex.en: The report gives a vivid picture of the market.
ex.zh: 這份報告生動地描繪了市場狀況。

vivid.en: so clear and detailed that you can imagine it easily

ex.en: The new logo uses vivid colors.
ex.zh: 新商標使用了鮮豔的顏色。

ex.en: She wore a vivid red dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件鮮紅色洋裝去派對。

vivid.en: very bright and strong in color

ex.en: The answer leads us to a vicious circle.
ex.zh: 回答把我們帶入了一個惡性迴圈。

ex.en: The vicious dog attacked the postman.
ex.zh: 那隻凶惡的狗攻擊了郵差。

ex.en: He spread vicious rumors about his rival.
ex.zh: 他散布關於對手的惡毒謠言。

vicious.en: cruel and meant to hurt someone badly

vigorous.zh: 精力充沛的、強而有力的

ex.en: He is a vigorous old man who still runs every morning.
ex.zh: 他是個精力充沛的老人，每天早上還跑步。

ex.en: The committee launched a vigorous campaign against pollution.
ex.zh: 委員會展開了強而有力的反汙染運動。

vigorous.en: strong, healthy and full of energy

ex.en: He still works with the vigor of a young man.
ex.zh: 他工作起來仍然像年輕人一樣精力充沛。

ex.en: The team returned to the field with new vigor.
ex.zh: 球隊帶著新的活力回到場上。

vigor.en: physical or mental strength and energy

ex.en: The woodpecker is pecking the tree trunk vigorously.
ex.zh: 啄木鳥正在使勁地啄樹幹。

ex.en: She shook her head vigorously to say no.
ex.zh: 她用力地搖頭表示不同意。

ex.en: The company vigorously denied the rumors.
ex.zh: 公司強烈否認了這些謠言。

vigorously.en: in a strong and energetic way

ex.en: My grandmother was a kind and virtuous woman.
ex.zh: 我外婆是一位善良又有德行的女性。

ex.en: He tries to live a virtuous life by helping others.
ex.zh: 他努力透過幫助別人過有德行的生活。

virtuous.en: behaving in a good and moral way

ex.en: Try to visualize yourself giving a great speech.
ex.zh: 試著想像自己發表一場精彩的演講。

ex.en: I can't visualize what the new house will look like.
ex.zh: 我想像不出新房子會是什麼樣子。

visualize.en: to form a picture of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: The new student was victimized by bullies at his school.
ex.zh: 那個轉學生在學校被惡霸欺負。

ex.en: Scammers often victimize elderly people living alone.
ex.zh: 詐騙集團常常以獨居老人為下手對象。

victimize.en: to treat someone unfairly or cruelly on purpose

ex.en: The video quickly went viral.
ex.zh: 這部影片很快就爆紅了。

ex.en: Her post went viral overnight.
ex.zh: 她的貼文一夜之間爆紅。

viral.en: spreading very quickly to a lot of people on the internet

ex.en: The doctor said it was a viral infection.
ex.zh: 醫生說這是病毒感染。

ex.en: Antibiotics don't work on viral diseases.
ex.zh: 抗生素對病毒性疾病無效。

viral.en: caused by a very small living thing that makes people ill

ex.en: The lender asked for updated cash-flow figures to assess the project’s viability.
ex.zh: 貸款機構要求提供最新現金流數據，以評估專案是否可行。

ex.en: Rising material costs have put the plan’s financial viability at risk.
ex.zh: 材料成本上漲，讓這項計畫的財務可行性受到影響。

viability.en: the ability to work well, succeed or stay alive

ex.en: The visionary founder anticipated changes in the industry.
ex.zh: 這位有遠見的創辦人預見了產業變化。

ex.en: Her visionary strategy attracted new investors.
ex.zh: 她具遠見的策略吸引了新投資人。

visionary.en: having clear and wise ideas about what will happen or what to do in the future

ex.en: We booked a viewing for the townhouse on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們預約週六看這間連棟住宅。

ex.en: The agent arranged a private viewing after work.
ex.zh: 房仲安排下班後帶我們單獨看屋。

viewing.en: an arrangement to go and look at a house or flat that is for sale or rent

ex.en: This is the finest view I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最美麗的景色。

ex.en: This tower commands a full view of the city.
ex.zh: 從這座塔上可以看到整個城市的景色。

view.en: everything that you can see from a particular place

ex.en: Concerning this problem, our views are not the same.
ex.zh: 在這個問題上，我們的看法不一樣。

ex.en: Sometimes he has difficulty being articulate about his views.
ex.zh: 他有時很難把自己的看法說清楚。

view.en: an opinion or way of thinking about something

ex.en: I viewed my action as a crime.
ex.zh: 我把自己的行為看成是犯罪。

ex.en: Many people view the plan as too risky.
ex.zh: 很多人認為這個計畫風險太高。

view.en: to think about something in a particular way

ex.en: If your visa expires, you must leave China.
ex.zh: 如果簽證過期，你就必須離開中國。

ex.en: I applied for a visa.
ex.zh: 我申請了簽證。

ex.en: You don't need a visa.
ex.zh: 你不需要簽證。

visa.en: an official stamp or document that lets you enter or stay in a country

ex.en: I visited the house in which Shakespeare was born.
ex.zh: 我去參觀了莎士比亞出生的房子。

ex.en: We visited his home country for the first time.
ex.zh: 我們第一次去了他的家鄉。

visit.en: to go to a place to see it and spend time there

ex.en: Tom visits Mary every time he goes to Boston.
ex.zh: 湯姆每次去波士頓都去看瑪麗。

ex.en: He comes to visit us every now and then.
ex.zh: 他偶爾會來看我們。

visit.en: to go to see a person and spend time with them

ex.en: This is my first visit to Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這是我第一次來台灣。

ex.en: We paid a visit to our grandparents last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末去探望了祖父母。

visit.en: a time when you go to see a person or place

visual aid.zh: 視覺輔助工具（圖表、投影片等）

ex.en: Using visual aids makes your presentation easier to follow.
ex.zh: 使用視覺輔助工具能讓簡報更容易理解。

ex.en: The teacher used maps as visual aids.
ex.zh: 老師用地圖當作視覺輔助工具。

visual aid.en: a picture, chart or slide used to help people understand a talk

ex.en: We flew to Paris via Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我們經由東京飛往巴黎。

ex.en: You can reach me via email at any time.
ex.zh: 你隨時都可以透過電子郵件聯絡我。

ex.en: She sent the photos to me via a messaging app.
ex.zh: 她透過通訊軟體把照片傳給我。

ex.en: Tickets can be bought online via our website.
ex.zh: 可以透過我們的網站線上購票。

ex.en: They rented a villa near the beach for the summer.
ex.zh: 他們在海灘附近租了一棟別墅過夏天。

ex.en: The villa has a large garden and a swimming pool.
ex.zh: 這棟別墅有大花園和游泳池。

ex.en: Victoria studies biology at the university.
ex.zh: 維多利亞在大學念生物。

ex.en: I'm sending the invitation to Victoria tonight.
ex.zh: 我今晚要把邀請函寄給維多利亞。

ex.en: They live in a beautiful Victorian house near the park.
ex.zh: 他們住在公園附近一棟漂亮的維多利亞式房屋裡。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of Victorian clothing.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了大量維多利亞時代的服飾。

ex.en: Many Victorians believed that hard work was the key to success.
ex.zh: 許多維多利亞時代的人相信努力工作是成功的關鍵。

ex.en: The book describes how a typical Victorian lived.
ex.zh: 這本書描述了典型維多利亞時代的人是怎麼生活的。

ex.en: Vietnam is a country in Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 越南是東南亞的一個國家。

ex.en: We tried delicious noodle soup on our trip to Vietnam.
ex.zh: 我們去越南旅行時吃了好吃的湯麵。

virgin.zh: 未經開發的；初始的；純的

ex.en: The hikers walked through a virgin forest.
ex.zh: 健行者走過一片原始森林。

ex.en: I prefer virgin olive oil on my salad.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在沙拉裡淋初榨橄欖油。

ex.en: Vienna is the capital of Austria.
ex.zh: 維也納是奧地利的首都。

ex.en: We spent a weekend in Vienna listening to classical music.
ex.zh: 我們在維也納度過一個週末，聽了古典音樂。

ex.en: The train to Vienna leaves from platform four.
ex.zh: 開往維也納的火車從四號月台出發。

virginia.zh: 維吉尼亞（美國東部的一個州）

ex.en: Virginia is a state on the east coast of the United States.
ex.zh: 維吉尼亞是美國東岸的一個州。

ex.en: We drove through Virginia on our way to Florida.
ex.zh: 我們在前往佛羅里達的途中開車經過維吉尼亞。

ex.en: Virginia has been teaching piano for over thirty years.
ex.zh: 維吉尼亞教鋼琴已經超過三十年了。

ex.en: They named their daughter Virginia after her grandmother.
ex.zh: 他們依據祖母的名字，把女兒取名為維吉尼亞。

ex.en: It helps to listen to someone else's viewpoint before you decide.
ex.zh: 做決定之前，先聽聽別人的觀點會有幫助。

ex.en: From my viewpoint, the plan is too expensive.
ex.zh: 從我的角度來看，這個計畫太貴了。

ex.en: The article presents a different viewpoint on the issue.
ex.zh: 這篇文章提出了對這個議題不同的看法。

ex.en: Mix some vinegar and oil to make a salad dressing.
ex.zh: 把醋和油混合，就可以做成沙拉醬。

ex.en: The pickles were kept in vinegar for a week.
ex.zh: 這些醃菜在醋裡泡了一個星期。

ex.en: You can clean the window with vinegar and water.
ex.zh: 你可以用醋和水來擦窗戶。

ex.en: Visiting hours at the hospital start at two o'clock.
ex.zh: 醫院的探病時間從兩點開始。

ex.en: Visiting old friends is the best part of coming home.
ex.zh: 拜訪老朋友是回家最棒的部分。

ex.en: The Vikings sailed across the sea in long wooden ships.
ex.zh: 維京人乘著長木船橫越大海。

ex.en: A Viking from Scandinavia may have reached North America before Columbus.
ex.zh: 一位來自斯堪地那維亞的維京人，可能比哥倫布更早抵達北美洲。

ex.en: A green vine grew up the wall of the old house.
ex.zh: 一株綠色的藤蔓沿著老房子的牆往上爬。

ex.en: The farmer picked grapes straight from the vine.
ex.zh: 農夫直接從葡萄藤上摘葡萄。

ex.en: The plant vines quickly along the fence in summer.
ex.zh: 這種植物在夏天會很快沿著圍籬蔓延生長。

ex.en: Beans will vine up the poles if you give them support.
ex.zh: 只要給豆子支撐，它們就會沿著竿子往上攀爬。

ex.en: The vicar greeted everyone at the church door.
ex.zh: 教區牧師在教堂門口向每個人問好。

ex.en: Our village vicar lives in the house next to the church.
ex.zh: 我們村裡的教區牧師住在教堂旁邊的房子。

ex.en: She speaks Vietnamese at home with her parents.
ex.zh: 她在家裡和父母說越南語。

ex.en: Many Vietnamese enjoy a cup of strong coffee in the morning.
ex.zh: 許多越南人喜歡早上喝一杯濃咖啡。

ex.en: Every villager came to the festival in the square.
ex.zh: 每一位村民都來參加廣場上的慶典。

ex.en: A villager showed us the way to the old well.
ex.zh: 一位村民為我們指了去老井的路。

ex.en: The villagers share the water from the river.
ex.zh: 村民們共用這條河的水。

ex.en: The victor of the match received a gold cup.
ex.zh: 這場比賽的勝利者得到一座金盃。

ex.en: After a long game, our team was the victor.
ex.zh: 經過一場漫長的比賽，我們隊成為贏家。

ex.en: History is often written by the victor.
ex.zh: 歷史常常是由勝利者來書寫的。

ex.en: The website is visually appealing and easy to use.
ex.zh: 這個網站在視覺上很吸引人，又好操作。

ex.en: The test was designed to help visually impaired students.
ex.zh: 這項考試是為了幫助視覺障礙的學生而設計的。

ex.en: She bought a vintage dress at the flea market.
ex.zh: 她在跳蚤市場買了一件復古洋裝。

ex.en: My uncle drives a vintage car from the 1960s.
ex.zh: 我叔叔開一輛一九六○年代的古董車。

ex.en: The vintage of this wine is printed on the label.
ex.zh: 這瓶酒的年份印在標籤上。

ex.en: Experts say it was an excellent vintage.
ex.zh: 專家說那一年是很棒的好年份。

ex.en: The wind shook the windows violently all night.
ex.zh: 風整夜猛烈地搖晃著窗戶。

ex.en: He reacted violently when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到消息時反應很激烈。

ex.en: Vincent is a common given name in Europe.
ex.zh: 文森特是歐洲常見的男子名。

ex.en: The name Vincent comes from a Latin word meaning to conquer.
ex.zh: 文森特這個名字源自拉丁文，意思是征服。

ex.en: I felt a slight vibration when the train passed by.
ex.zh: 火車經過時，我感覺到輕微的震動。

ex.en: Turn your phone to vibration mode during the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時請把手機調成震動模式。

ex.en: The city has a vibrant nightlife and many street markets.
ex.zh: 這座城市有活力十足的夜生活和許多街頭市集。

ex.en: She is a vibrant young woman full of ideas.
ex.zh: 她是個充滿點子、朝氣蓬勃的年輕女孩。

ex.en: The garden was full of vibrant red and yellow flowers.
ex.zh: 花園裡開滿了鮮豔的紅花與黃花。

ex.en: He painted the wall a vibrant shade of blue.
ex.zh: 他把牆漆成了鮮豔的藍色。

ex.en: Fog reduced visibility on the highway to a few meters.
ex.zh: 濃霧使公路上的能見度降到只剩幾公尺。

ex.en: Visibility was good, so we could see the mountains clearly.
ex.zh: 能見度很好，所以我們能清楚看到群山。

ex.en: The campaign increased the visibility of the local shops.
ex.zh: 這項活動提高了當地店家的曝光度。

ex.en: Better signs would improve the visibility of our shop.
ex.zh: 更好的招牌能提高我們店面的能見度。

ex.en: There are no hotels in the vicinity.
ex.zh: 這附近沒有旅館。

ex.en: The police searched the vicinity of the park.
ex.zh: 警方搜查了公園附近一帶。

ex.en: The old man still walks with surprising vigour.
ex.zh: 那位老先生走起路來仍然精力充沛得驚人。

ex.en: She started the new job with great vigour.
ex.zh: 她充滿活力地開始了新工作。

ex.en: The villain in the movie wants to take over the world.
ex.zh: 電影裡的反派想統治全世界。

ex.en: Kids often cheer for the hero and boo the villain.
ex.zh: 孩子們常常為英雄歡呼，對反派喝倒采。

ex.en: The old story tells of a cruel villain who cheated the villagers.
ex.zh: 那個古老的故事講述了一個欺騙村民的殘忍惡棍。

ex.en: The police finally caught the villain after a long chase.
ex.zh: 警方在長時間追捕後終於抓到了那名歹徒。

ex.en: Three teams are vying for the championship.
ex.zh: 三支球隊正在爭奪冠軍。

ex.en: Many shops vie for the attention of tourists.
ex.zh: 許多商店都在爭取遊客的注意。

ex.en: The old man still has great vitality for his age.
ex.zh: 這位老先生以他的年紀來說仍然很有活力。

ex.en: Fresh air and exercise bring vitality to the body.
ex.zh: 新鮮空氣和運動為身體帶來活力。

ex.en: I still remember my first day of school vividly.
ex.zh: 我仍然清楚記得上學的第一天。

ex.en: The author vividly describes the old market in the morning.
ex.zh: 作者生動地描寫了早晨的老市場。

ex.en: The colors of the sunset were vividly reflected in the lake.
ex.zh: 夕陽的色彩鮮明地倒映在湖面上。

ex.en: From the top, a beautiful vista of the valley opened up.
ex.zh: 從山頂望去，山谷的美景展現在眼前。

ex.en: The window offers a lovely vista of the sea.
ex.zh: 這扇窗戶可以看到海邊的美景。

ex.en: New vistas opened up for her after college.
ex.zh: 大學畢業後，新的前景在她面前展開。

ex.en: We toured a family-run vineyard in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了鄉間一座家族經營的葡萄園。

ex.en: The vineyard produces grapes for red wine.
ex.zh: 這座葡萄園生產釀紅酒用的葡萄。

ex.en: My phone began to vibrate during the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時我的手機開始震動。

ex.en: I set my phone to vibrate so it won't disturb anyone.
ex.zh: 我把手機設成震動，免得吵到別人。

ex.en: The windows vibrate whenever a truck drives past.
ex.zh: 每當卡車經過，窗戶就會顫動。

ex.en: The guitar string vibrates when you pluck it.
ex.zh: 你撥弦時，吉他弦會振動。

ex.en: She was visibly nervous before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前她明顯很緊張。

ex.en: The crowd was visibly moved by his speech.
ex.zh: 群眾明顯被他的演說感動了。

ex.en: The river has visibly risen after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後，河水明顯上漲了。

ex.en: My father still collects vinyl and plays it every weekend.
ex.zh: 我爸爸仍在收集黑膠唱片，每個週末都會播放。

ex.en: Many people say vinyl sounds warmer than digital music.
ex.zh: 許多人說黑膠聽起來比數位音樂更溫暖。

ex.en: The floor is covered with easy-to-clean vinyl.
ex.zh: 地板鋪著容易清理的乙烯基塑膠。

ex.en: She bought a vinyl raincoat for the trip.
ex.zh: 她為這趟旅行買了一件塑膠雨衣。

ex.en: My dad still keeps our old family videotape in a drawer.
ex.zh: 我爸爸還把我們家的舊錄影帶收在抽屜裡。

ex.en: The police studied the videotape of the street.
ex.zh: 警方研究了那條街的錄影帶。

ex.en: They videotaped the whole wedding ceremony.
ex.zh: 他們把整場婚禮都錄了下來。

ex.en: The teacher videotapes each class so absent students can watch it.
ex.zh: 老師把每堂課錄影，讓缺課的學生可以觀看。
